title: Verb + ing (like/hate/love) - Verbs followed by gerunds

options.answer: I enjoy to swim in the ocean.
I enjoy swimming in the ocean.
I enjoy swim in the ocean.

explanation.en: The verb 'enjoy' is always followed by a gerund (verb + ing), not an infinitive.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'enjoy' всегда используется с герундием (глагол + ing), а не с инфинитивом.
explanation.uz: 'Enjoy' fe'li doimo gerundiy (fe'l + ing) bilan ishlatiladi, infinitiv bilan emas.

options.answer: She hates to get up early.

explanation.en: The verb 'hate' requires a gerund (getting) when expressing general preferences.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'hate' требует герундий (getting) при выражении общих предпочтений.
explanation.uz: 'Hate' fe'li umumiy afzalliklarni ifodalashda gerundiy (getting) talab qiladi.

explanation.en: The verb 'love' takes a gerund (dancing) when expressing general preferences or habits.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'love' принимает герундий (dancing) при выражении общих предпочтений или привычек.
explanation.uz: 'Love' fe'li umumiy afzalliklar yoki odatlarni ifodalashda gerundiy (dancing) oladi.

options.answer: He keeps to forget his keys.

explanation.en: The verb 'keep' must be followed by a gerund (forgetting) to mean 'continue doing something'.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'keep' должен следовать с герундием (forgetting) в значении 'продолжать делать что-то'.
explanation.uz: 'Keep' fe'li 'biror ishni davom ettirish' ma'nosida gerundiy (forgetting) bilan ishlatilishi kerak.

options.answer: They avoid to eat fast food.

explanation.en: The verb 'avoid' is always followed by a gerund (eating), never an infinitive.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'avoid' всегда используется с герундием (eating), никогда с инфинитивом.
explanation.uz: 'Avoid' fe'li doimo gerundiy (eating) bilan ishlatiladi, hech qachon infinitiv bilan emas.

options.answer: I don't mind to help you.

explanation.en: The expression 'don't mind' requires a gerund (helping), not an infinitive.
explanation.ru: Выражение 'don't mind' требует герундий (helping), а не инфинитив.
explanation.uz: 'Don't mind' iborasi gerundiy (helping) talab qiladi, infinitiv emas.

options.answer: She finished to write the letter.

explanation.en: The verb 'finish' is always followed by a gerund (writing) to show completion of an action.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'finish' всегда используется с герундием (writing) для обозначения завершения действия.
explanation.uz: 'Finish' fe'li harakatning tugashini ko'rsatish uchun doimo gerundiy (writing) bilan ishlatiladi.

options.answer: We suggest to go to the park.
We suggest going to the park.
We suggest go to the park.

explanation.en: The verb 'suggest' takes a gerund (going), not an infinitive, when followed directly by a verb.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'suggest' принимает герундий (going), а не инфинитив, когда за ним следует глагол.
explanation.uz: 'Suggest' fe'li to'g'ridan-to'g'ri fe'l bilan ergashganda gerundiy (going) oladi, infinitiv emas.

options.answer: He can't stand to wait in long lines.
He can't stand waiting in long lines.
He can't stand wait in long lines.

explanation.en: The expression 'can't stand' requires a gerund (waiting) to express strong dislike.
explanation.ru: Выражение 'can't stand' требует герундий (waiting) для выражения сильной неприязни.
explanation.uz: 'Can't stand' iborasi kuchli yoqmaslikni ifodalash uchun gerundiy (waiting) talab qiladi.

options.answer: They postponed to have the meeting.

explanation.en: The verb 'postpone' is followed by a gerund (having) to indicate delaying an action.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'postpone' используется с герундием (having) для обозначения откладывания действия.
explanation.uz: 'Postpone' fe'li harakatni kechiktirishni ko'rsatish uchun gerundiy (having) bilan ishlatiladi.
